questions.question: A man starts off a journey. He travelled for 16 hours in total. First half of the distance was covered at 40 km/h and the second half at 60 km/h. What was the distance covered?
questions.solution:
Let the total distance be 2x km, then

x/40 + x/60 = 16

⇒ (3x + 2x)/120 = 16

⇒ 5x/120 = 16

⇒ x = 16 × 24

⇒ x = 384

Total distance = 384 × 2 = 768 km.

The difference of cubes of two numbers is 999. The numbers are in the ratio of 4 : 3. What is the square of the smaller number?
questions.solution:
Let the ratio of two number is = 4x : 3x

According to the question

(4x)³ - (3x)³ = 999

⇒ 64x³ - 27x³ = 999

⇒ 37x³ = 999

⇒ x³ = 999/37 = 27

⇒ x = ∛27

⇒ x = 3

Square of the smaller number = (3x)² = (3 × 3)² = 81

A student scored 32% marks and failed by 6 marks. Had he scored 36%, he would have passed by 2 marks. What is the passing score?
questions.solution:
Let the maximum marks be x

Condition First

Pass marks = x × (32/100) + 6 ---(1)

Condition Second

Pass marks = x × (36/100) - 2 ---(2)

From equation (1) and equation (2)

32x/100 + 6 = 36x/100 - 2

⇒ (36x - 32x)/100 = 6 + 2

⇒ 4x/100 = 8

⇒ x = 8 × (100/4)

⇒ x = 200

From equation (1)

Pass marks = 200 × (32/100) + 6 = 64 + 6 = 70

questions.question: An article was sold for Rs. 500. Had the selling price been 10% less, the profit would have been 12.5%. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
12.5% = 1/8 and 10% = 1/10

Let the cost price of the article be Rs. x

According to the question

⇒ x = 500 × (9/10) × (8/9)

⇒ x = 400

So, the cost price of the article is Rs. 400.

questions.question: How much time will it take a principal of Rs. 640 to yield Rs. 768 as an amount at 2.5% simple interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 768

P = 640 

r = 2.5%

**Concept used:**

SI = Prt/100

P → princiapl r → rate of interest t → time

**Calculation:**

SI = 768 - 640 = 128

128 = (640 × 2.5 × t)/100

⇒ t = (128 × 100)/(640 × 2.5)

⇒ t = 8 years.

questions.question: The ratio between the volume (in cm³) and the curved surface area (in cm²) of a cylinder is numerically 14 : 1. If the height of the cylinder is 50 cm, then what is the volume of the cylinder? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
As we know,

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

Curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

Height of the cylinder (h) = 50 cm

According to the question

πr²h/2πrh = 14/1

⇒ r/2 = 14

⇒ r = 14 × 2

⇒ r = 28 cm

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h = (22/7) × 28 × 28 × 50 = 123200 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 123200 cm³**.

questions.question: 6 pencils cost Rs. 30 and 12 pens cost Rs. 120. What is the average cost of 50 pencils and 50 pens?
questions.solution:
Cost of 6 pencils = Rs. 30

Cost of 1 pencil = 30/6 = Rs. 5

Cost of 50 pencils = 5 × 50 = 250

Cost of 12 pens = Rs. 120

Cost of 1 pens = 120/12 = Rs. 10

Cost of 50 pens = 10 × 50 = 500

Average cost of 50 pens and 50 pencils = (500 + 250)/100 = 750/100 = Rs. 7.5

questions.question: If selling price of a product is multiplied by 2, then the resultant profit is 6 times the original profit. What is the original profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the CP and SP of the article be Rs. x and Rs. y respectively, then

⇒ 2y - x = 6 (y - x)

⇒ 2y - x = 6y - 6x

⇒ 6x - x = 6y - 2y

⇒ 5x = 4y

x : y = 4 : 5

Now, we can say

CP of the article = Rs. 4

SP of the article = Rs. 5

Profit = 5 - 4 = 1

Profit percentage = (1/4) × 100 = 25%

According to the question

questions.question: A family consists of two grandparents, two parents and four children. Two years ago, the average age of the grandparents was 72 years. One year ago, the average age of parents was 36 years. At present, the average age of the children is 12 years. What is the present average age of the family?
questions.solution:
Two years ago average age of two grandparents = 72

Two years ago sum of age of two grandparents = 72 × 2 = 144

Sum of age of two grandparents (present) = 144 + 4 = 148

One year ago average age of two parents = 36

One year ago sum of age of two parents = 36 × 2 = 72

Present sum of age of two parents = 72 + 2 = 74

Average age of 4 children = 12

Sum of age of 4 children = 12 × 4 = 48

Sum of age of all family (8 members) = 148 + 74 + 48 = 270 years

Average age of all family = 270/8 = 33.75 years

questions.question: A company bought a machine for Rs. 40000 and spent Rs. 10000 on its repair. After some time, the machine was sold for Rs. 45000. How much discount was offered?
questions.solution:
Cost of machine for company = 40,000

Company spent on machine = Rs. 10,000

Final cost of machine = Rs. 40,000 + Rs. 10,000 = Rs. 50,000

Company sold the machine = Rs. 45,000

Discount = Rs. 50,000 - Rs. 45,000 = Rs. 5,000

Discount percentage = (5,000/50,000) × 100 = 10%

questions.question: A and B can together complete a task in 21 days. If A alone takes 42 days to complete the task, the number of days that B would take to do the task alone is:
questions.solution:
A alone can complete the task in = 42 days

A and B alone can complete the take in = 21 days

Let B alone can complete the task in x days,

According to the question

1/42 + 1/x = 1/21

⇒ x = 1/21 - 1/42

⇒ x = (2 - 1)/42

⇒ x = 1/42

So, B alone can complete the whole task in 42 days.

**Short Trick:**

B alone can complete the whole task in = (42 × 21)/(41 - 21) = 42 days

questions.question: The median of the first seven prime numbers, is:
questions.solution:
The first seven prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17

n = 7 (odd number)

Median = [(n + 1)/2]th = [(7 + 1)/2] = 4th

4th term is 7.

So, the median of the first seven prime numbers, is 7.
